build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm run prepare:sidecar && pnpm --dir ../frontend run dev --host 127.0.0.1
build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm run prepare:sidecar && pnpm --dir ../frontend run build:desktop

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'
